meta.name: amplitude-automation
meta.description: Automate Amplitude tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): events, user activity, cohorts, user identification. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动完成 Amplitude 事件、用户分析和分群操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Amplitude 中手动执行重复的数据操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate Amplitude events, user analysis, and cohort operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently perform repetitive data tasks in Amplitude

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你向 Amplitude 发送事件、查询用户活动、管理用户属性和人群，以及浏览事件类别。
howto.when: 当你需要操作 Amplitude 数据（如记录用户行为、查看用户历史、更新用户属性或管理人群）时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下用户 user_123 的最近活动。
say.note: Claude 会先查找用户，再返回活动事件列表。

say.text: 发送一个 'purchase' 事件给用户 user_456。
say.note: Claude 会调用发送事件工具。

say.text: 列出所有人群，并把用户 user_789 添加到人群 'VIP' 中。
say.note: Claude 会先列出人群，再更新成员。

howto.what_en: Claude can send events to Amplitude, look up user activity, manage user properties and cohorts, and browse event categories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to interact with Amplitude data, such as recording events, viewing user history, updating user properties, or managing cohorts.

say_en.text: Look up recent activity for user user_123.
say_en.note: Claude will find the user first, then return activity events.

say_en.text: Send a 'purchase' event for user user_456.
say_en.note: Claude will call the send event tool.

say_en.text: List all cohorts and add user user_789 to cohort 'VIP'.
say_en.note: Claude will list cohorts first, then update membership.
